Privacy policy

This portfolio is operated by Satyarth Mishra. Questions or requests about information you share can be sent to mishrasatyarth61@gmail.com.

Browsing

The hosting provider may process technical request information such as IP addresses, timestamps and requested pages to serve and secure the site. The 3D experience loads a display font from Google Fonts; your browser connects to Google for that font. The text pages use system fonts.

Messages

The contact form prepares an email draft in your email application. It does not send your message to this site’s server. Information you choose to send is used to respond to your enquiry and manage the resulting conversation. Please do not include sensitive personal information. You may request deletion of correspondence by email; records needed for an ongoing matter may need to be retained.

Analytics and storage

No analytics or session-recording services are currently enabled. When analytics are enabled, your consent choice is saved in this browser’s local storage. You can change it through Privacy settings. Declining does not prevent access to the portfolio.

External services

GitHub, LinkedIn, project demos and other linked services have their own privacy practices. Following a link takes you to that service. This site does not sell your contact information.

Updates

This notice will be updated when the site’s data handling changes.
